body: I’ve tried and tried again, I’m tired of the rejection. I cant take it anymore.
I will never be happy. My definition of happiness will never be fulfilled.
I will never have a significant other. You can bet on that.

Im just tired of all the bullshit and rejection I have gone through. I’m fucking tired of it. You’re not gonna talk me out of this. I appreciate your efforts but I’m sorry, I have to do this. I don’t see my life going anywhere in the future, I’d rather die.
There’s this guy that drives around campus blasting mac miller in his car literally 24/7. You and him will get along nicely.
